NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 4, 8:53 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate at 28.9 DraftKings points for $10,000, at Miami. Kenneth Walker III (24.2, $9,000) and Christian McCaffrey (21.8, $8,000) are next.

Jahmyr Gibbs is also the top value at the position: 2.90 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 4, 8:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 9

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET at MIA ($10,000)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 28.9 DraftKings points at $10,000, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.8 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 23.1 carries and 5.3 targets. The salary works out to 2.90 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 29.0 points with a simulated floor of 16.5 and a ceiling of 45.8, and he holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 7-point favorite on the road against Miami, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs NYJ ($9,000)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 24.2 DraftKings points at $9,000, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 21.4 carries and 3.8 targets. The salary works out to 2.69 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 24.3 points with a simulated floor of 12.1 and a ceiling of 41.4, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 10-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF vs LV ($8,000)

Christian McCaffrey projects 3rd at the position with 21.8 DraftKings points at $8,000. The model gives him 14.0 carries and 5.2 targets. The salary works out to 2.73 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 24 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 10.1 and a ceiling of 40.4, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 10-point favorite at home against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 31.25 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Value: Jonah Coleman, DEN at CAR ($5,300)

Jonah Coleman projects for 14.8 DraftKings points at $5,300, which works out to 2.80 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 24 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 8.5 carries and 2.9 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Coleman averaged 14.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 31.2, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Denver is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Carolina, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.
